about: The tools the host itself offers a person's AI. A recipe may name them although no tool row of the Workshop does; every other tool a recipe names must be a Workshop tool, or recipeToolGaps reports it. Adding a host tool is adding a row here; no code edit.

tools.meaning: Say something to the person in the place they already are, with links they can open.
Open a page in the person's own browser, signed in as they are, and read what it shows.
